newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo precious metal futures end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo precious metal futures end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Yen-denominated Tokyo precious metal futures ended narrowly mixed on Wednesday in very thin trade, as the market received little direction from the currency market, traders said.
Gold prices ranged from two yen per gram lower to one yen firmer. Benchmark August was two yen lower at 1,342 yen.
Bullion was quoted at $382.85/383.15 per ounce at the Tokyo close, against $382.70/383.20 in New York on Tuesday.
Traders said gold was expected to move within narrow ranges ahead of the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) board meeting to discuss its gold sales plan.
